business.businessType_note: Global Surf Adventures is a multi-destination surf travel agency (Israel). The only place it runs itself is Global Surf Lodge Kabalana (Ahangama, Sri Lanka): 12 rooms plus weekly level-based surf packages (lessons + bed + meals) — that is a surf_camp, and it is what this dossier harvests as the core. Maldives, Morocco, Angola and Mozambique are resold/partner trips; they are recorded under other_destinations[] with their own sources. The schema has no home for a multi-destination agency (see gaps).

description_packages.value: At Global Surf Lodge Kabalana, we provide our guests with a unique, holistic stay which combines surf, yoga & wellness, local culture, and nature. Join us for a special tropical experience on the beautiful South Coast of Sri Lanka. We offer weekly retreats, available for all levels.

day_at_the_camp.value: Wake up to stretch and strengthen your mind, body, and soul with yoga in the tropics. Then grab your board and head out with your group for a refreshing morning surf session. A big, healthy breakfast will be waiting for you when you get back. Afterwards, you can either relax at the lodge or explore the extraordinary surrounds before heading out for your afternoon surf. End your day with an epic dinner together with the other guests and soak up the electric aloha vibes.

existing_site.notes: Agency site, not a lodge site: the lodge is one of five destinations. Faults: (1) no prices anywhere on the site — they exist only inside the engine after picking guests and a date; (2) every lodge/level booking button goes through a '/tests/' Bookinglayer URL (or bookinglayer.io/#/category/8337) that dumps the visitor on the engine home, losing the package they chose; (3) first mobile load of the home page 13.4 MB / 133 requests, the lodge page 20 MB / 191 requests (one unthrottled run, measured to load+5 s, no scroll); autoplay video hero; 16–21 third-party hosts incl. Google Ads/DoubleClick, Facebook pixel, GA, YouTube, Elfsight Instagram feed, Kuula 360° viewer, Messenger chat bubble over the content; (4) stale: footer '© 2019', key pages last modified 2023, Maldives charter schedule for 2024, retreats 2023/2025, surf & yoga popup 2023; (5) the lodge's address, check-in times and the Sri Lankan phone number are not on the site (only the Israeli HQ phone and WhatsApp); (6) typos in headings and engine product names ('Fomies', 'malidves', 'TREATMETNS', 'AMMINITIES', 'Kabalna', 'What’sup', 'Kabbalah'); (7) site and engine disagree on what each package includes (yoga ×5 on the site, none in the engine; spa treatment in the engine, not on the site); (8) the Freestylers B&B package is advertised but has no bookable dates; (9) contact form's destination list omits Mozambique.

languages.note: Israel-registered company, Hebrew spoken per Booking.com, many Israeli guest names in testimonials

gaps.why: site-content.md is one business = one place. Global Surf sells five destinations; only the Kabalana lodge fits the schema (surf_camp). Maldives/Morocco/Angola/Mozambique/retreats can only be squeezed into copyBlocks[]/priceList[] rows, which would lose their own seasons, places and booking paths. Not proposing a new module (would be a second 'site' per destination, out of scope); recommend the site be the lodge's, with at most one copy block pointing to the agency's other trips.
no price appears on globalsurf.com; they exist only in the engine after choosing guests and a date
B&B package advertised but no bookable dates in the engine through 2027-09-30
site and engine list different inclusions for every level; which one is current cannot be told from public material
package price is per person for 7 nights; site-content priceList[].unit has 'per_week' and 'per_person' but not both — the note must carry '7 nights'

four sources give four different room lists (site 4 twin/4 double-triple/4 family; engine dorm + shared twin; Booking deluxe double/superior twin/dorm bed; ISA page double/shared). No source gives per-room sleeps for all; rooms[] can be seeded from Booking/engine names only
every booking CTA on the site lands on the engine home, not the package ('/tests/' URLs)
only an Israeli WhatsApp is published; the lodge’s Sri Lankan number appears only on Google
the lodge address and check-in/out times are not on globalsurf.com (only on Google/Booking)
n/a for a lodge; stayInfo carries check-in/out
Google limited view truncates 4 of 5 quotes; Booking truncates 4 of 10; no dates on Booking quotes
no current team names published except "Ariel, a professional surf guide" inside a testimonial; the 2019 staff list on surfcamp-online is probably stale
the lodge’s own pages only say "year-round"; the Oct–Apr main season is from a ~2019 third-party listing
not published on the site; Booking says it varies by room; BookSurfCamps snippet (30% deposit) unverified
several surf photos on the Kabalana pages are from elsewhere per filename (Hikkaduwa) or not identifiable; flagged per image

contradictions: Room inventory: site "4 twin, 4 double/triple, 4 family" vs lodge page "from 4 beds dorms to … private rooms" vs engine (Mixed dorm 4 beds; Shared Twin = one double + one single bed) vs Booking (Deluxe Double, Superior Twin 2 singles, dorm bed) vs surfcamp-online (dorm / twin / double, 32 beds).

Package inclusions: site level pages list yoga ×5, 1-on-1 feedback ×2, full-day surf trip, filming day; engine lists 7 days equipment, 1 feedback, 1 Ayurvedic spa treatment, half-day excursion, no yoga, no full-day trip.
Freestylers page says both "half board … breakfast and dinner" and "accommodation and breakfast only".
Package start day: engine Saturdays (2026–27); surfcamp-online (~2019) "start every Sunday".
Spot names: "The Rock & South point" (site, 2024) vs "South Beach … Kabalana main point … Kabalana beach break" (surfcamp-online, ~2019).

Address spelling: Google "Henewatta addara gederawata, Ahangama 80650" vs Booking "Henewaththa Addara Gedarawaththa Kathaluwa, 80650 Ahangama" vs surfcamp-online "… Kathaluwa Thiththagalla Rd …". Site uses Google’s (playbook §6).
Phones: HQ +97299733943 and WhatsApp +972523593240 (site, Israel) vs lodge +94770776747 (Google only). Not a conflict of the same channel, but the site shows no Sri Lankan number.
Property class: Booking "Hostel", Google "3-star hotel", site "boutique resort".
Mozambique season: "April … until November" and "April – September" on the same page.
Instagram followers: scout saw 17K (meta) vs 2K (rendered); this pass rendered 17.2K.
Prices: surfcamp-online (~2019) "from 855€ per Week" (surf & yoga) and "from 255€" (B&B) vs engine $1466 per person per week (2026–27).
